Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty is one of the most talented and versatile vocalists of India. His soft, soothing voice carries an emotional appeal and an ease of expression. He has made a name for himself in the fields of Khayal and Thumri. Many consider him to be the spiritual successor to the late maestro, Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan and a leading exponent of the Patiala Gharana.
In this video he sings a Surdas bhajan - Jag Me Jeevath Hai No Tho.
